featured_reviews.review_text:
Takes multiple holidays EVERY WEEK.

Says he's sorry to inform. I don't think so.

If you want to take holiday every week, you better shut off your business. Clearly, you don't know how to do service.

Increased price by rs. 10 without any whatsoever modifications in the tiffin and asked us to somehow magically “understand.”

Why should I? My money is getting wasted because I still get the same bland food, no new vegetable dishes, hardly any specials as was “promised” when I had enquired. Infact, the menu is pretty much narrowed after the price hike despite it not being rainy season YET.

Terrible food tiffin service.

Not to mention that this tiffin service didn't even serve on 31st December night. When it should have, considering the party environment  outside which is not really safe at night.

He serves to students, even then, he will take so much more holidays than what was said by him when asked. He said 2 per month, which would be sundays. But since past few months, he's been taking as many as 3 one week accounting up to 5-6 per month.

And even after everything, we still get the tiffin late. Pray tell, why do I even pay and what do I even pay you for??? One time, I got cold tiffin food delivered at 11 PM at night. I'm not even kidding. And he had pretty rudely handled the phone calls of enquiry asking me to cancel the tiffin and get food from somewhere else.

Very pathetic service. Don't recommend it to anyone. It's not a “tiffin” service at all.

Just made for namesake so as to loot the poor students.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I was wanting to try this home made meal from a long time and finally could manage to try it last night. The team is very courteous and eager to ensure a pleasant food experience. The meal which is priced quite economically at 120rs inclusive of home delivery charges comes in plastic containers and rotis in safe and nice packing. The meal had a portion of white rice which were of good quality which is hard to find such tiffin services, a container portion of dal which was plain with mild tadka and just the kind you would expect at home that suits all taste buds, rotis were typical sindhi style that is very soft with a touch of oil and last was the paneer capsicum which was mildly dry and had onion in it too.

Overall the meal was pretty good and so was the service. I will be giving it a few more try soon again to experience more items.

I've been availing their services since June 2024 and am a delighted customer.

I can't praise them enough. Great food, great service and a delight!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been ordering from Yummy Tiffins on a daily basis, and it has been a great experience so far. The combination of  bhaji, rotis, salad, and dal/soup makes for a filling and well-balanced meal at a very reasonable price.

One of the best things about their service is the monthly menu planning you get the entire month’s menu in advance, which makes it super convenient. Even better, you can easily cancel tiffin for specific days directly on their website, without the hassle of calling or messaging.

The monthly subscription discount is another big plus, making it even more value-for-money. Also, the variety in cuisines like kofta, thecha, noodles, pasta, soup keeps things interesting, I never really got bored of the food.

featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered for the first time from here. What I liked about this service provider is that we can choose the dishes from their daily menu, this I think is a brilliant way to reduce food wastage. We had ordered Rajma, Chapati, Chole Rice bowl and Dal Khichdi bowl. The only item I liked was Rajma. Chapati was alright, but chole rice bowl lacked gravy and was spicy. The dal khichdi was tasteless but was cooked well. The rice in the chole bowl was cooked well too. The good part was the food wasn't oily, but the taste can be definitely improved. Food arrived on time and was packed well. Ordering the food from the website was hassle-free.
